Job description:
We are looking for an AI Agent Engineer; someone who has not just worked with the APIs of language models, but has real experience in designing and developing intelligent Agents and Agentic systems. If you have built an Agent yourself to date, have worked with LLMs, Tool Calling, memory, workflows, RAG, and Orchestration, and enjoy building systems that can understand goals, make decisions, use tools, and pursue a task to the end, then you might be the right fit for our team. Responsibilities include designing and developing usable AI Agents in the product, designing the architecture of Agentic and Multi-Agent systems, connecting Agents to tools, APIs, databases, and internal services, implementing Tool Calling / Function Calling with LLMs, designing Prompts / Context, implementing Memory and managing Context, developing RAG and Knowledge-based systems, designing multi-step and reliable workflows, evaluating, debugging, and improving Agent performance, paying attention to cost, Latency, Reliability, and output quality. Close collaboration with the Product and Backend teams to turn AI capabilities into real products is what is very important to us. Practical experience is more important to us than degrees or the names of tools. We are not looking for someone who has only taken AI courses or built a few chatbots with APIs. It would be a huge plus if you could show and explain one of the Agents you have previously built: What problem did the Agent solve? How did it make decisions? What Tools did it have access to? How did you manage Context and Memory? If the Agent made a mistake, how did you detect and correct it? How did you measure the quality and cost of the system? A real GitHub repository, sample project, or Demo is very valuable. Required skills include practical experience with LLMs and language model APIs in Python and/or TypeScript, experience building AI Agents or Agentic Workflows, familiarity with Tool Calling / Function Calling, familiarity with RAG, Embedding, and Vector Databases, familiarity with one or more Agentic Frameworks such as: LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar tools. You don't need to know all these tools; understanding the architecture and real system building experience is more important to us than the name of the Framework. It is an advantage if you have experience building Production-grade Agents, working with Multi-Agent systems, having experience connecting Agents to real databases and APIs, familiarity with LLM system Observability and Evaluation, experience working with Docker and Cloud services, familiarity with Backend and service architectures, and experience building AI products, not just prototypes. Our company is a cloud accounting platform for small businesses, and we are currently exploring and developing the next generation of AI capabilities to help business owners with their daily tasks. Our goal is not to build another Chatbot. We want AI to be able to perform tasks; to examine information, select the appropriate tools, interact with accounting systems, and accomplish a portion of the user's real-world tasks within a defined scope. This is why we need someone who can move beyond the idea and prototype stage and turn an Agent into a reliable system in a real product. To apply for collaboration, please send your resume, and if you have experience building Agents, please also send a sample project, GitHub, Demo, or a short explanation of one of the Agents you have built yourself. In this role, a real project you have built is more valuable to us than several pages of a resume.

Company description:
A mobile and cloud accounting platform, active since 1396, with over 100,000 users in Iran. With world-class technologies, we make the financial management of small businesses independent and professional. ★ Our work values ✓ Independence and Responsibility — Freedom with mutual trust ✓ Creativity instead of routine — New ideas are valuable ✓ Agile and proactive team — Without heavy administrative processes ✓ Borderless — Transparent decision-making and direct communication ✓ Real coordination — Aligned, not isolated ✓ Performance-based pay — Based on the real impact of the individual and the team ✓ Space for growth — Continuous progress, not fixed roles ★★★ Join our team in Shiraz if you want to work with modern technologies and grow in a startup team with a culture of independence, creativity, and real teamwork, we look forward to getting to know you.
